title: Nritya Sangam: Group Dance Battle
description: Crews of 6 to 12 take the main stage for a 7-minute set in any style, from classical fusion to hip-hop. Judged on choreography, sync, energy and costume.

title: Solo Steps
description: A solo dance showcase with a 3-minute limit per performer. Bring your own track on a pen drive; any style is welcome.

title: Battle of Bands
description: Live bands play original or cover sets of up to 15 minutes. Drum kit and amps are provided; bring your own instruments and pedals.

title: Unplugged Acoustic Night
description: An intimate acoustic session for solo singers and duos. One acoustic guitar or keyboard per act, five minutes each.

title: Nukkad Natak: Street Play
description: Teams stage a 12-minute street play on a social theme of their choice, performed in the round with no props or microphones.

title: Mono Act
description: One performer, one character, four minutes. Original scripts score higher than adaptations.

title: Threads: Theme Fashion Walk
description: Teams present a themed collection on the runway in an 8-minute walk. This year's theme is 'Rewoven': outfits built from repurposed fabric.

title: Hack the Fest: 12-Hour Build
description: Build something that makes a college fest run better, from ticketing to crowd flow. Teams of up to four, 12 hours, with mentors on hand.

title: RoboRace
description: Wired or wireless bots race through an obstacle track with ramps, sand and a see-saw. Bot must fit inside a 30 cm cube.

title: Spin a Yarn: Creative Writing
description: Write a short story in 60 minutes from a prompt revealed on the spot. English and Tamil entries are judged separately.
